contract: NFRA_CTLPLN C-REGISTRY (FWD-2): the ONE place a box is named. Every script that names devices reads this file; a box is added here once and nowhere else.
identity: A box's own name comes from the user environment variable AGENTBUS_DEVICE, set once at bring-up. It is never derived from a path (LD-0405).
